column3: Day one. You only came in for a frozen pizza.
Midnight. A cashier, a manager, an old man and his dog. That's everyone.
Then the doors slide open... and a man in a lab coat falls through them.
Behind him, the parking lot is full of people. They're just not walking right.
Lock the doors! Lock the doors, now!
Every scream makes them hit the glass harder.
Then the store music gets louder... and they just lose interest.
They follow noise. This awful song is the only thing hiding us.
Sorry. It does that near loud speakers.
Nobody notices the one by the ice chest. It just... stops moving.
Keep this cold. Whatever happens to me, keep it cold.
He's shaking now. And the manager keeps scratching his wrist.
Freezer. Lock him in before he turns.
Or we put him out the back. Now. While he still can't bite.
He's still breathing. And he's still looking at you.
Do you lock him in the freezer, or put him outside?
